display_long_description:
Ealtic is a mixed reality app that lets people experience and learn the wisdom, stories, and traditions behind ancient Indian culture in an interactive and immersive way. Step into timeless stories, celebrate vibrant festivals, and experience the wisdom of tradition in a whole new way. Using hand tracking, you interact directly with characters, sacred objects, and festive rituals - right in your own space. 
[media]

Ealtic is more than cultural storytelling. It is also about mindfulness and balance. Through immersive visuals and reflective experiences, the app encourages relaxation, presence, and connection with heritage.
[media]

For anyone curious about India’s timeless traditions or seeking meaningful cultural discovery, Ealtic transforms history into a living, interactive journey. With Ealtic, the real and virtual merge into a world of celebration, wisdom, and inner harmony.
[media]
